weeks.theme: Do-it-right compliance: policy acknowledgments, phishing, and data handling

scenarios.title: Confirming Code of Conduct acknowledgment before the deadline
scenarios.situation: A system glitch prevents your acknowledgment from showing as complete. You need to email HR/Compliance to confirm you read the policy, note the due date, attach proof, and request confirmation that your record is updated.
targetPhrases: Per the 2026 Code of Conduct
I acknowledge I have read and will comply
Please confirm my completion is recorded
Before the [date] deadline
For your reference, see attached screenshot
If additional steps are needed, please let me know
scenarios.successLooksLike: A 4–5 sentence email with a clear subject line that states the policy name and due date, confirms acknowledgment, includes evidence (screenshot or LMS ID), and politely asks for written confirmation—no back-and-forth needed.

scenarios.title: Reporting a suspected phishing email to IT Security
scenarios.situation: You receive a password-reset email from an odd domain. You must report it through the approved channel without clicking anything and alert your team lead.
targetPhrases: I’m reporting a suspected phishing email
I have not clicked any links or opened attachments
Submitted via the Phish Alert button
The sender domain does not match our company domain
Please advise if we should notify the team
Quarantined/deleted per guidance
scenarios.successLooksLike: A short report sent via the approved tool plus a confirmation email/Slack message to Security with the indicators of compromise (odd domain, urgent tone, mismatched URL) and explicit statement you did not interact with the message.

scenarios.title: Sharing a file with customer data securely
scenarios.situation: Finance needs a spreadsheet that includes customer emails and phone numbers. You must share it without emailing the raw file and set the correct permissions and expiry.
targetPhrases: Contains PII; sharing via restricted link
Only people in our organization with the link
Do not forward
Access expires on [date]
Redacted version attached for reference
Please confirm receipt
scenarios.successLooksLike: A SharePoint/Drive link with org-only access and expiration, plus a brief note that labels the data as PII and requests confirmation—no attachments with raw data are sent.

weeks.theme: Audits, incidents, and vendor compliance handoffs

scenarios.title: Responding to an internal audit sampling request
scenarios.situation: Internal Audit requests three Q2 expense receipts within 48 hours while you are traveling. You need to send the documents, map each to the sampled transaction, and ask for a short extension if needed.
targetPhrases: Per your request dated [date]
Attached are receipts for the selected transactions
Requesting a short extension until [date] due to travel
Happy to provide any additional detail
Please confirm if this satisfies the request
scenarios.successLooksLike: One concise email with correctly labeled attachments (transaction IDs, dates, amounts), a specific extension request (if needed), and a confirmation ask—Audit can close the item without chasing you.

scenarios.title: Filing a minor data incident after misdirected email
scenarios.situation: You accidentally sent a customer list (names and emails, no financial data) to one outside recipient. You must notify the Data Protection Officer and open a ticket with scope, containment, and next steps.
targetPhrases: I’m reporting a potential data incident
Email sent to one unintended recipient
No financial data or passwords included
Recipient confirmed deletion
Incident logged as [ticket #]
Requesting guidance on notification requirements
scenarios.successLooksLike: A complete ticket and email to the DPO that states what happened, who was affected, what data was involved, containment performed, and the ticket number—no missing fields.

scenarios.title: Chasing vendor compliance documents before contract signature
scenarios.situation: Procurement needs the vendor’s SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA before issuing a PO. The vendor is late. You must send a firm, polite deadline and offer help if they need a template.
targetPhrases: As part of due diligence
Please provide current SOC 2 Type II and signed DPA
We cannot proceed without these documents
Deadline: [date] at [time] [timezone]
If you need a template, let us know
We will escalate per policy if not received
scenarios.successLooksLike: A crisp email that lists required documents, a specific deadline, and the consequence of delay, with a helpful offer of templates—vendor replies with the correct attachments on time.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: Everyone completes the short program and turns in clean drafts that Compliance doesn’t have to fix.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: 95% session completion; 85% of draft emails/tickets pass first review with zero redlines.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: People can spot a phish and share sensitive files the right way without asking for help.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: In simulations, 90% correctly identify phishing red flags and choose the org‑only, time‑limited sharing setting.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: When Audit asks for documents, the reply is correct the first time.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: 80% of learners assemble a complete audit reply (all fields, labeled attachments) within 10 minutes.

kickoffMessage.en: Welcome to the 2‑week English for Compliance program for cross‑functional teams. Goal: check the box quickly and do it right. Schedule: 2 sessions per week, 30 minutes each. Deliverables: one policy‑acknowledgment email (sim), one phish report (sim), and one audit reply or incident ticket (template). All activities are in English with fast, practical feedback—no extra tests beyond the required check‑ins. Let’s get this done efficiently and accurately.
kickoffMessage.ko: 교차 기능 팀을 위한 2주간 컴플라이언스 영어 프로그램에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 목표는 빠르게 요건을 충족하면서 정확하게 수행하는 것입니다. 일정: 주 2회, 회당 30분. 과제: 정책 확인 이메일(시뮬레이션) 1개, 피싱 신고(시뮬레이션) 1개, 감사 요청 회신 또는 인시던트 티켓(템플릿) 1개. 모든 활동은 영어로 진행되며, 실무형 피드백을 빠르게 제공합니다. 필요한 체크 외의 추가 시험은 없습니다. 효율적이고 정확하게 완료합시다.
